mission: Grow a compounding flat-to-VR capability factory: turn verified external knowledge, Battle Bridge proof and Stephan's headset judgement into reusable methods that accelerate Starfield VR and every later conversion.
overview: The Lab now coordinates a 23-source VR knowledge stack rather than a small collection of game notes. Every source retains provenance, licence, freshness, confidence and reuse boundaries.

Starfield VR is the flagship proving ground. The current path combines Starfield and Creation Kit authoring evidence, Mutar/OpenXR implementation evidence, Skyrim VR parity references and exact Quest 3 Battle Bridge proof.

CyberpunkVR Port adds a current open implementation reference for genuine per-eye engine rendering, OpenXR, embodiment, tracked hands, physical weapons, holsters, stereo HUD and in-headset diagnostics.
The Witcher 3 route adds a different conversion grammar: compose a first-person camera adapter, stereo presentation layer and creator headset evidence when a native engine route is unavailable.

Headset-VR adds a configuration-recipe evidence plane: executable-specific profiles, CVars, 6DoF controller setup, camera modes, scripts, runtime constraints and install-order knowledge with community authorship preserved.
Meta Air Link over Wi-Fi is Stephan's primary PCVR transport. Virtual Desktop is a separately proven alternative; wired Meta Link is unavailable and must never be requested as a fallback.

A resistant game is no longer classified as impossible. The route ladder continues through engine adapters, title-specific adapters, external reconstructed stereo, spatial-screen presentation and lawful independent recreation.
Compounding agency is the governing measure: each experiment should leave reusable interfaces, tests, methods, evidence and licence freedom behind.

techniques.name: Capability Route Planner
techniques.goal: Select native, framework, title-adapter, reconstructed-stereo, spatial-screen or independent-recreation routes from evidence rather than guesswork.

techniques.name: Starfield Mutar OpenXR Baseline
techniques.goal: Bind the exact installed Starfield and provider files to pinned provenance, Meta OpenXR and Quest 3 Air Link proof.

techniques.name: Skyrim VR Parity Decomposition
techniques.goal: Translate VRIK body/holsters, HIGGS interaction and PLANCK character response into named Starfield attachment points and acceptance tests.

techniques.name: Genuine Dual-view Engine Rendering
techniques.goal: Extract the CyberpunkVR Port method for independent eye cameras, dual frame-graph execution, graceful mono fallback and stage-by-stage runtime diagnostics without assuming REDengine hooks exist in Creation Engine.

techniques.name: Transport-neutral Hand Pose Contract
techniques.goal: Separate OpenXR or SteamVR tracking producers from title-specific skeleton adapters using a bounded pose contract, calibration and explicit source/licence boundaries.

techniques.name: Composable Third-person VR Route
techniques.goal: Evaluate camera adaptation, proprietary stereo presentation and scene-specific fallbacks as a lawful route for games without a native OpenXR conversion.

techniques.name: Configuration Profile Recipe Extraction
techniques.goal: Turn game-specific Headset-VR profiles into provenance-aware recipes covering executable identity, runtime, render/camera mode, CVars, plugins, scripts, controller mappings, caveats, rollback and local headset proof.

techniques.name: Room-fixed 3D Cutscene Theatre
techniques.goal: Preserve authored cinematic framing on a room-fixed stereo screen while retaining full 6DoF head tracking, then evolve it into a Starfield-aware Presentation Controller.

techniques.name: Adaptive Dialogue Presentation
techniques.goal: Use Starfield's Dialogue Camera preference as an intent signal: immersive dialogue when safe, focused conversation when requested and theatre only for forced cinematic camera ownership.

techniques.name: Monocular Flat-to-VR Reconstruction
techniques.goal: Observe authorised flat gameplay, estimate temporally stable depth and camera motion, accumulate a confidence-aware proxy scene and synthesize coherent stereo for resistant games.

techniques.name: Quest 3 Air Link Acceptance
techniques.goal: Treat Meta Air Link over Wi-Fi as the primary route and attribute failures across application, OpenXR, encode, network, decode, compositor and headset layers.

techniques.name: Virtual Desktop Presentation Adapter
techniques.goal: Use Virtual Desktop as an optional operational benchmark and SBS/VDXR transport without coupling sovereign reconstruction or Starfield logic to proprietary internals.

techniques.name: Licence Bottleneck Radar
techniques.goal: Classify reuse rights, dependency centrality and withdrawal risk early, then reuse, isolate, replace or stop before licence constraints become structural.

techniques.name: Continuous Source Discovery
techniques.goal: Detect material releases, licence changes, compatibility evidence and permissive alternatives, then promote only verified findings into the Capability Graph.

experiments.title: Starfield VR exact Air Link launch path
experiments.hypothesis: A pinned Starfield build and approved provider can launch through Meta OpenXR and active Quest 3 Air Link with exact identities, fail-closed readiness and a durable receipt.
experiments.notes: Issue #1595 owns the read-only Battle Bridge packet. Do not claim the desktop shortcut is usable until readiness and one operator-authorised headset launch pass.

experiments.title: Living Starship vertical slice
experiments.hypothesis: A bounded ship slice combining cockpit presence, spatial UI, embodied interaction, crew behaviour and stable Air Link delivery will reveal the highest-value path toward the blow-my-mind Starfield.
experiments.notes: Use the Starfield VR Reference Lab recipe once PR #1642 is repaired, visually accepted and merged.

experiments.title: Starfield VR adaptive dialogue and cinematic controller
experiments.hypothesis: Starfield's Dialogue Camera setting plus camera-control telemetry can select immersive dialogue, focused conversation or room-fixed theatre without forcing the headset camera.
experiments.notes: Test both Dialogue Camera states, normal conversations, scripted scenes, pre-rendered video, subtitles and return-to-gameplay transitions.

experiments.title: CyberpunkVR Port method and licence extraction
experiments.hypothesis: Pinning the exact repository revision and dependency graph will yield reusable dual-view, embodiment and diagnostic methods without importing title-specific or restrictively packaged content.
experiments.notes: Pin the exact GitHub commit, reconcile repository and Nexus version labels, inventory dependency licences and keep Quest 3 Air Link proof separate.

experiments.title: VoodooDE Witcher 3 VR route extraction
experiments.hypothesis: The current showcase can reveal a repeatable composed route and its comfort boundaries once the exact video, game, mod, vorpX, headset and runtime versions are pinned.
experiments.notes: Operator reported the showcase on 2026-08-05. Do not invent the video ID or promote assumptions about the route.

experiments.title: Beardo Benjo Cyberpunk VR field-evidence extraction
experiments.hypothesis: Creator headset evidence can identify setup, motion-control, visual, performance and comfort gaps that direct source documentation does not expose.
experiments.notes: The June 9, 2026 showcase title is indexed, but its exact permalink remains pending. Treat all claims as field evidence requiring source and local corroboration.

experiments.title: Headset-VR configuration-recipe extraction
experiments.hypothesis: Normalising several Headset-VR profiles into one provenance-aware recipe schema will expose reusable last-mile configuration primitives that can drive route planning, launch packets and repeatable headset verification.
experiments.notes: Start with publicly indexed Alien Isolation, Aliens Fireteam Elite, KARMA and Nobody Wants to Die examples. Preserve original community profile authorship and do not rehost restricted attachments.

experiments.title: Offline monocular reconstruction to coherent SBS
experiments.hypothesis: A permitted prerecorded sequence can produce temporally stable depth and a dual-eye proxy render with measurable comfort advantages over one-original-eye/one-synthetic-eye presentation.
experiments.notes: Issue #1643 begins offline. Record disocclusion holes, edge mismatch, temporal shimmer, processing latency and all model/component licences.

experiments.title: Air Link versus Virtual Desktop transport comparison
experiments.hypothesis: A transport-neutral output contract can preserve identical game/reconstruction logic while Air Link and Virtual Desktop are measured independently for latency, image quality and stability.
experiments.notes: Air Link is primary. Virtual Desktop must never be silently substituted and wired Meta Link is unavailable.

experiments.title: Canonical source registry projected into the Lab tile
experiments.hypothesis: Rendering the registry and unlock state directly will prevent the visible Lab from drifting behind canonical knowledge.
experiments.notes: This workspace refresh closes the immediate drift. A follow-on should make the tile consume knowledge-sources.json dynamically rather than relying on manual duplication.

integrationSeams: Capability Graph seam: every promoted method retains provider, revision, evidence plane, confidence, licence and Starfield attachment point.
Source-registry seam: future UI should derive source cards and counts directly from knowledge-sources.json so visual truth cannot lag canonical truth.
Licence seam: proprietary and analysis-only sources inform requirements but remain isolated behind Stephanos-owned interfaces and replacement plans.

Implementation seam: CyberpunkVR Port contributes direct source methods while Universal Hands contributes a transport-neutral tracking interface; neither creator field evidence nor title-specific assets may be mistaken for reusable code.
Creator-evidence seam: VoodooDE, Beardo Benjo, Headset-VR and Paradise Decay observations remain field evidence linked to exact videos/posts, versions, hardware and timestamps.

Configuration-profile seam: Headset-VR recipes bind exact executable, profile author, runtime, CVars, scripts, controller mappings and tested state without conflating the distributor with the original profile author.
Presentation seam: immersive world, focused dialogue, room-fixed theatre and safe curved-screen modes share one VR Presentation Controller.
Transport seam: Starfield and reconstructed stereo emit through a transport-neutral boundary; Air Link is primary and Virtual Desktop is optional.
Reconstruction seam: resistant games can feed temporal depth, proxy-map and stereo-synthesis experiments without touching protected renderer internals.
Battle Bridge seam: exact installed identity, hashes, runtime state, Air Link session, logs and physical headset judgement remain the promotion authority.
Compounding-agency seam: every accepted experiment must return reusable code, tests, methods, evidence or licence freedom to later projects.
Spatial seam: the future Quest surface consumes canonical Stephanos projections and never owns separate goals, memory, approvals, execution queues or evidence.
